spells.name: Magic Arrow
spells.description: Deals direct magical damage to a single enemy stack.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.description: Strikes target with lightning from above.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: Engulfs target hex and adjacent hexes in flames.

spells.name: Haste
spells.description: Increases unit speed and combat movement range.

spells.name: Slow
spells.description: Reduces unit speed by 50% rounded down.

spells.name: Cure
spells.description: Removes negative spells and heals wounded creatures.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.description: Restores dead creatures to the target friendly stack.

spells.name: Meteor Shower
spells.description: Bombards a wide 2-hex radius area with falling meteors.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: Strikes target with high-voltage lightning cascading across combatants.
